fields.summary_ko.0: Seagate Technology (STX) Q1 revenue expected to increase 58% year-over-year to $415 million (record highest growth rate), net income expected to increase 185% to $7.43 per share.
fields.summary_ko.1: STX fell over 30% in October but up 135% year-to-date, Bank of America target price increased to $1,200 (previous $1,150), Morgan Stanley also raised to $1,200.
fields.summary_ko.2: Analysts focus on data center storage demand outlook through 2030~2031, pricing, margins, and expansion of Mozaic HAMR drives.
